title: ShopBack Super Swap Gift Cards: 2.5% Cashback on $100, [Westpac, StG, BoM, BSA] 3% Bonus Cashback ($20 Cap/Order) @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: ShopBack Super Swap Gift Cards: 2.5% Cashback on $100, [Westpac, StG, BoM, BSA] 3% Bonus Cashback ($20 Cap/Order) @ ShopBack

[daanish] Note: Adore Beauty, Bunnings Warehouse and Sephora AU cards are currently unavailable for swapping.
I can confirm Amazon and 7-Eleven Activ Visa gift cards are still available though.
[Hiphopopotamus] Bunnings is possibly temporary, see ShopBack Home Swap Gift Card (Bunnings Warehouse temporarily unavailable) .
[Avalanche] Hope it comes back soon or atleast they add Woolies in there :D
[ATangk] $666 will cap out the bank bonus, so buy 6 x $100 to max it out.
[sintro] To keep it under $20 bonus cap per order.
[SydBoy] Is there a list where we can use them ? Is it possible to swap for 7/11 or shell or BP ?
[Onemoredeal] Just live checked for you using one of mine, Ampol, 7/11, Shell
[Save Medicare] How ? 7-Eleven isn't on the list on the page?
[Onemoredeal] I’m on the prezzie app, searched “7” or “fuel” from the swap page of my superswap and 7-eleven eGift Card is there . I’ve never used it it’s there though
[Save Medicare] @Onemoredeal: Nice. Done. Sadly I bought the $500 GC not realising it was only 1.5% not 2.5%. Oh well. Should be good for a couple of days of fuel.
Helpfully the mycardwallet app is terrible.
[VladImpaler] Not exactly the same but there is a Prezzee Pay Supermarket card to swap to.
[Onemoredeal] That’s very recent as I swapped my last lot only a few weeks ago for Woolies/bigw combo card . I just checked and you are correct. That’s a shame
[hamza23] Woolworths have never been a part of Shopback Super Swap gift cards. Previously EG fuel were, which actually worked at Woolworths ( https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/950817 ).
[Onemoredeal] I’m looking at them now, I bought superswap ShopBack cards on 31/8, and I swapped 2 x $100 to Amazon and 2 x 100 to Woolworths essentials but the Woolworths ones I only did within the last few weeks . They are still in my prezzie wallet and I’ve never used anything in prezzie except superswap . Maybe it was a temporary error for a few weeks
[hamza23] @Onemoredeal: Oh my bad, yeah it must have been a recent temporary thing, I didn't see it on my 31/8 cards but I swapped them pretty quickly.
I looked at past deals and on 31/8 someone else said Woolworths weren't available , prior on 10/7 but nothing since then.
[Onemoredeal] @hamza23: You know it didn’t even dawn on me that they had never been included. And I remember previous posts saying they weren't I guess I never thought about it at the time when they popped up. Anyways regardless it’s definitely not available now
[Crowing] Bunnings has 1% cash back + 4% with Apple Pay. If any one needs a top up
[BargainKnight] I wish they have bp as I use 9c off from CBA yello which makes it cheaper then u-go in my local area.
Has anyone tried PrezzeePay Supermarkets eGift Card and PrezzeePay fuel eGift Card? It looks attractive but don't know where accepts union pay.
